chunks.text: Students can download a lesson as audiobook and listen offline in the mobile app.
To reset your password, open the login page and choose the forgot password link. An email arrives within ten minutes.
A subscription renews every year. You can cancel it in account settings before the renewal date.
Practice quizzes show the correct answer and a short explanation after each question.
The study planner builds a weekly schedule from the exam date and the hours you have per day.
Support answers messages on weekdays from 9 to 18 in the chat inside the app.
